cases.relationship: Son / stepson / partner's son / child's partner
cases.narrative:
Her body was found during a welfare check. Deputies entered through an unlocked door and located her unresponsive, with swollen eyes and blood coming from her nose. During an interview with detectives, he allegedly said he believed he had killed his mother after arguing about school and finances. According to court documents obtained by the outlet, he allegedly said he put her in a chokehold, threw her to the ground, and “curb-stomped” her neck several times. 

According to an affidavit, “[Le] noted how angry he was and that he likely killed her on the ‘third stomp’ and ‘over-killed her’ and stomped her four or five more times,” Us magazine reports. Le then allegedly wrapped her in blankets, which he said was to “heal” her, and allegedly listened to her make noises for about 30 minutes before she died. He then allegedly gave her a hug.
